name: Thermo Fisher Scientific
description: Thermo Fisher sells the equipment, consumables, chemicals and outsourced services that scientists use in labs, hospitals and drug factories. It is an industrial-style distributor and manufacturer more than a health care company: its customers are pharma and biotech firms, universities, hospitals, governments and industrial labs, and the money comes from instruments (one-time), consumables and reagents (repeat), the Fisher Scientific distribution channel (low margin), and contract research and manufacturing for drug makers (PPD clinical research, drug-product services). FY2025 revenue was $44.6 billion (up 4 percent) with GAAP operating margin 17.4 percent. The company deploys capital mainly through acquisitions, most recently Clario ($9.1 billion, closed 2026-03-24).

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC code is 3829 (Measuring & Controlling Devices, NEC), from the EDGAR submissions record.

hq.note: 168 Third Avenue, Waltham, MA 02451 (FY2025 10-K cover); Delaware corporation

employees.note: About 125,000 colleagues: 59,000 Americas, 22,000 Asia-Pacific, 44,000 Europe. FY2025 10-K

businessLines.name: Laboratory Products and Biopharma Services
businessLines.how: Two different models in one segment: low-margin resale of other companies' and its own lab supplies to labs (repeat purchases), and fee-for-service contracts from drug companies to run clinical trials and make drug product over multi-year terms.
businessLines.description: Fisher Scientific and Unity Lab Services distribution and lab consumables and equipment, plus pharma services (PPD clinical research, drug development and manufacturing) and the research and safety market channel.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income, non-GAAP basis; FY2024 3,090 (13.3%). Share is of total segment income $10,110M

businessLines.name: Life Sciences Solutions
businessLines.how: Mostly consumables and reagents that customers reorder every batch or experiment, plus some instruments; biopharma customers buy bioproduction supplies in proportion to the drug volume they manufacture.
businessLines.description: Reagents, instruments and consumables for biological research and biopharma production: bioproduction (filtration and single-use products), genetic sciences (Olink, Applied Biosystems).

businessLines.name: Analytical Instruments
businessLines.how: One-time sale of expensive lab instruments (capital purchases by labs, semiconductor makers and universities) followed by service contracts and consumables.
businessLines.description: Electron microscopes, chromatography and mass spectrometry, chemical analysis instruments.

revenue.note: Before eliminations; FY2024 7,463; organic revenue flat

businessLines.revenueNote: Before eliminations; FY2024 7,463; organic revenue flat

operatingProfit.note: Segment income, non-GAAP basis; FY2024 1,955 (26.2%); decline attributed to tariffs and related currency, strategic investments and mix

businessLines.name: Specialty Diagnostics
businessLines.how: Test kits and reagents sold to hospitals and clinical labs on repeat orders, with instruments placed to pull through the consumables.
businessLines.description: Diagnostic tests, immunodiagnostics, transplant diagnostics, microbiology and healthcare market consumables.
